name: jira-flow
description: ACTIVATE THIS POWER whenever the user's message contains a Jira ticket key ({PREFIX}-{NUMBER}, e.g. ABC-1234) or an Atlassian issue URL (https://<site>.atlassian.net/browse/KEY-123) -- ALWAYS, with NO exception for extra content in the same message. A ticket key or URL activates this power whether it stands alone OR is accompanied by screenshots, images, pasted bug descriptions, annotations like 'image 1 = wrong, image 2 = correct', requirements, or any other text. That accompanying material is NOT a separate task to investigate directly -- it is additional context for Step 1 of the jira-pull workflow (folded into the ticket summary and the Step 3 scope confirmation), and the full branch-setup/questions/transition workflow still runs before any code is touched. Do not interpret a URL plus a bug description plus screenshots as 'the user wants me to go investigate/fix this now' -- that exact shape (URL + description + before/after images) is the most common real input and still means 'start working on this ticket' via the full workflow, not 'skip the workflow and start debugging'. Also activate on 'start ticket', 'jira-pull', 'jira-push', 'new ticket', 'close ticket', 'wrap up', 'done with this ticket', 'create an MR/PR'. Provides the end-to-end Jira ticket workflow: starting a ticket (branch setup, scope, navigation guide, time estimate) and closing a ticket (pre-push checks, commit, push, MR/PR, Jira transition, worklog). MANDATORY NEXT STEP: immediately after activating this power, call kiro_powers readSkill with skillName 'jira-pull' (to start a ticket) or 'jira-push' (to finish one) BEFORE any other action -- including fetching the Jira ticket, searching the codebase, or writing code. The activate response lists skill names only, not their steps; proceeding without readSkill silently skips branch creation, the blocking confirmation questions, the Jira status transition, and the time estimate.
